name: birdsi
description: birdsI from the terminal, the operations record for an app, built for coding agents: scan a codebase, read findings in plain words, approve fixes. Also runs the birdsI MCP server.
author: yasmeen-khalil

scripts.build:
esbuild src/birdsi.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/birdsi.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/birdsi.js
